# Synthetic audit fixture: machine serial numbers (SPEC §27) in the serial
# label spellings; a `machine` prefix word before the matched span needs no
# handling of its own, because the label matches a span inside the
# lowercased line. The value anchor keeps prose safe: a serial is ONE
# unbroken run carrying both a letter and a digit, so free text
# (`see the underside of the device`) never trips, and neither do pure-digit
# runs (a Terraform state file's `"serial": 57` growth counter) nor
# pure-letter words. Letters-then-digits serials (`ABC12345`) are covered
# by a dedicated third alternative. Synthetic values.
Machine Serial Number: C02ZQ0ABC123
Machine Serial Number: ABC12345
serial_number = "C02ZQ0ABC123"
"SerialNumber": "1A2B3C4D5E"
SERIAL-NUMBER: pf-2x9k1q
serial:CND1234567
# Prose and reference forms that must stay silent.
serial number: see the underside of the device
Serial Number: unknown
serial_number = each.value.serial
"serial": 123456789
